cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(125A_OriginalCreativeVxdLive LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(original_creative_vxd_live STATIC
    src/OriginalCreativeVxdLive.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeStereoWorklist.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeMidiEngine.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeSf2MainCompiler.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeVerifiedSf2Bank.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeSf2SourceReader.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeSf2ResourceBuilder.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeSf2RamUpload.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeRamScratchVoices.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativePanController.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeVolumeController.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeModulationController.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeProgramSelection.cpp
    src/OriginalCreativeProgramBankMap.cpp)
target_include_directories(original_creative_vxd_live PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(original_creative_vxd_live PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(original_creative_vxd_live PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
    target_compile_options(original_creative_vxd_live PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wconversion -Werror -pedantic)
endif()
add_executable(test_original_creative_vxd_live tests/test_original_creative_vxd_live.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_original_creative_vxd_live PRIVATE original_creative_vxd_live)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME original_creative_vxd_live COMMAND test_original_creative_vxd_live)
